acceptance: Each platform runs `tpcds_obt` at SF 0.01 and 0.1 from a clean checkout containing beab5557ef, and only runs where every query succeeds with `summary.validation == passed` are staged.
A cohort is admitted only if at least 3 platforms complete; failures are reported, not hidden.

Staged bundles are anonymized with internal manifests, the inventory is regenerated, and `results-data/validate_corpus.py` and `scripts/validate_submission.py --trust-internal-source --require-manifest` pass.
CORPUS_NOTES.md records the runs and REGENERATION.md no longer says OBT is SF >= 1 only.
The develop PR merges, the published-results mirror PR merges, and the site-inputs bundle that carries the bundles is reported.
description: TPC-DS OBT now accepts scales below 1 (PR #4088, beab5557ef), but the corpus and Explorer only have SF 1 OBT cohorts. Publish SF 0.01 and SF 0.1 cohorts from fresh local runs on the merged code. Each new cohort needs at least 3 rankable comparison identities (`results-data/validate_corpus.py`). Owner choice (2026-11-11): DuckDB, DataFusion, Apache Doris and LakeSail; SF 10 is not published.
